description: Main records (one record per injury accident) of the National Police Agency's open traffic accident statistics, 2019-2025, 2,182,298 accidents. Each record has the accident location as a point and 74 attributes on time, road and parties involved.

table:columns.name: statistics_year
table:columns.description: Original column: 資料年次. Year in which the accident was counted in the statistics. Use this year to match the National Police Agency's published totals. Some accidents that occurred near the end of a year are counted in the following year, so it can differ from occurred_year.

table:columns.name: record_type
table:columns.description: Original column: 資料区分. Record type. Always "本票" (main record) in this dataset.

table:columns.name: prefecture
table:columns.description: Original column: 都道府県名. Name of the prefectural police that handled the accident (in Japanese). Hokkaido is split by regional headquarters, e.g. "北海道（札幌方面）".

table:columns.name: police_station
table:columns.description: Original column: 警察署等名. Name of the police station that handled the accident (in Japanese).

table:columns.name: record_number
table:columns.description: Original column: 本票番号. Record number within the police station (string, with leading zeros). Identifies one accident together with statistics_year, prefecture and police_station.

table:columns.name: accident_severity
table:columns.description: Original column: 事故内容. Whether the accident was fatal ("死亡事故") or injury-only ("負傷事故").

table:columns.name: fatalities
table:columns.description: Original column: 死者数. Number of people killed (died within 24 hours of the accident).

table:columns.name: injuries
table:columns.description: Original column: 負傷者数. Number of people injured.

table:columns.name: route_name
table:columns.description: Original column: 路線名. Road route name (national route number, "一般市町村道" (municipal road), etc.).

table:columns.name: direction
table:columns.description: Original column: 上下線. Up or down carriageway. Null from 2022 onwards.

table:columns.name: location_code
table:columns.description: Original column: 地点コード. Location code along the route (string).

table:columns.name: municipality_code
table:columns.description: Original column: 市区町村コード. National Police Agency municipality code (3-digit string). It is numbered within each prefecture and is not the 5-digit local government code of the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications.

table:columns.name: occurred_at
table:columns.description: Added column (not in the source). Date and time the accident occurred (Japan Standard Time). Built from the occurred_* columns.

table:columns.name: occurred_year
table:columns.description: Original column: 発生日時_年. Year the accident occurred. Use statistics_year for year-on-year trends.

table:columns.name: occurred_month
table:columns.description: Original column: 発生日時_月. Month the accident occurred.

table:columns.name: occurred_day
table:columns.description: Original column: 発生日時_日. Day of month the accident occurred.

table:columns.name: occurred_hour
table:columns.description: Original column: 発生日時_時. Hour the accident occurred (0-23).

table:columns.name: occurred_minute
table:columns.description: Original column: 発生日時_分. Minute the accident occurred (0-59).

table:columns.name: day_of_week
table:columns.description: Original column: 曜日(発生年月日). Day of the week of the accident (Japanese, e.g. "月" = Monday).

table:columns.name: holiday
table:columns.description: Original column: 祝日(発生年月日). Relation of the accident date to a public holiday ("当日" = on the holiday, "前日" = the day before, "その他" = other).

table:columns.name: sunrise_hour
table:columns.description: Original column: 日の出時刻　　時. Hour of sunrise on the day of the accident. Null for 2019-2021.

table:columns.name: sunrise_minute
table:columns.description: Original column: 日の出時刻　　分. Minute of sunrise on the day of the accident. Null for 2019-2021.

table:columns.name: sunset_hour
table:columns.description: Original column: 日の入り時刻　　時. Hour of sunset on the day of the accident. Null for 2019-2021.

table:columns.name: sunset_minute
table:columns.description: Original column: 日の入り時刻　　分. Minute of sunset on the day of the accident. Null for 2019-2021.

table:columns.name: day_night
table:columns.description: Original column: 昼夜. Day or night, including twilight categories (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: weather
table:columns.description: Original column: 天候. Weather (Japanese labels, e.g. "晴" = clear, "雨" = rain).

table:columns.name: terrain
table:columns.description: Original column: 地形. Area type (Japanese labels, e.g. "市街地－人口集中" = urban, densely inhabited district).

table:columns.name: road_surface
table:columns.description: Original column: 路面状態. Road surface condition (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: road_shape
table:columns.description: Original column: 道路形状. Road configuration, e.g. intersection or single road section (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: roundabout_diameter
table:columns.description: Original column: 環状交差点の直径. Roundabout diameter class (Japanese labels). Null for 2019-2021.

table:columns.name: traffic_signal
table:columns.description: Original column: 信号機. Presence and type of traffic signal (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: roadway_width
table:columns.description: Original column: 車道幅員. Roadway width class (Japanese labels). For intersections it describes both crossing roads. Used to identify residential roads (roadway narrower than 5.5 m).

table:columns.name: road_alignment
table:columns.description: Original column: 道路線形. Road alignment, e.g. straight/curve and grade (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: collision_location
table:columns.description: Original column: 衝突地点. Where the collision occurred, e.g. road section or within an intersection (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: zone_regulation
table:columns.description: Original column: ゾーン規制. Zone regulation such as "ゾーン30" (30 km/h zone) (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: median
table:columns.description: Original column: 中央分離帯施設等. Median or centre-line facility (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: sidewalk_separation
table:columns.description: Original column: 歩車道区分. Separation between sidewalk and roadway (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: accident_type
table:columns.description: Original column: 事故類型. Accident type, e.g. vehicle-pedestrian, vehicle-vehicle rear-end, single vehicle (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_a_stop_sign
table:columns.description: Original column: 一時停止規制_標識（当事者A）. Stop sign on party A's approach (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_a_stop_marking
table:columns.description: Original column: 一時停止規制_表示（当事者A）. Stop road marking on party A's approach (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_a_age_group
table:columns.description: Original column: 年齢（当事者A）. Age group of party A (Japanese labels, e.g. "0～24歳"). Not the exact age; the youngest class is 0-24, so teenagers cannot be separated.

table:columns.name: party_a_type
table:columns.description: Original column: 当事者種別（当事者A）. Type of party A, e.g. passenger car, pedestrian, bicycle (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_a_vehicle_use
table:columns.description: Original column: 用途別（当事者A）. Use of party A's vehicle, e.g. private or commercial (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_a_vehicle_shape
table:columns.description: Original column: 車両形状（当事者A）. Body shape of party A's vehicle (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_a_speed_limit
table:columns.description: Original column: 速度規制（指定のみ）（当事者A）. Posted speed limit on party A's road (Japanese labels). Statutory default limits are not included.

table:columns.name: party_a_impact_point
table:columns.description: Original column: 車両の衝突部位（当事者A）. Impact points of party A's vehicle (first and second; Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_a_vehicle_damage
table:columns.description: Original column: 車両の損壊程度（当事者A）. Damage level of party A's vehicle (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_a_airbag
table:columns.description: Original column: エアバッグの装備（当事者A）. Airbag fitted and deployed for party A's vehicle (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_a_side_airbag
table:columns.description: Original column: サイドエアバッグの装備（当事者A）. Side airbag fitted and deployed for party A's vehicle (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_a_injury_severity
table:columns.description: Original column: 人身損傷程度（当事者A）. Injury severity of party A (Japanese labels, e.g. "死亡" = killed, "負傷" = injured).

table:columns.name: party_a_automatic
table:columns.description: Original column: オートマチック車（当事者A）. Whether party A's vehicle is an automatic (Japanese labels). Applies to passenger cars and trucks only. Null for 2019-2021. Converted from the source codes using the official code table.

table:columns.name: party_a_support_car
table:columns.description: Original column: サポカー（当事者A）. Whether party A's vehicle is a "Support Car" with driver-assistance safety features (Japanese labels). Null for 2019-2021. Converted from the source codes using the official code table.

table:columns.name: party_a_cognitive_test_days
table:columns.description: Original column: 認知機能検査経過日数（当事者A）. Days between party A's cognitive function test and the accident (4-digit string). "9999" means no test taken or more than 2,555 days. Null for 2019-2021. Kept as in the source.

table:columns.name: party_a_driving_practice
table:columns.description: Original column: 運転練習の方法（当事者A）. How party A learned to drive (Japanese labels). Null for 2019-2021. Converted from the source codes using the official code table. "0" is not in the code table and is kept as in the source.

table:columns.name: party_b_stop_sign
table:columns.description: Original column: 一時停止規制_標識（当事者B）. Stop sign on party B's approach (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_b_stop_marking
table:columns.description: Original column: 一時停止規制_表示（当事者B）. Stop road marking on party B's approach (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_b_age_group
table:columns.description: Original column: 年齢（当事者B）. Age group of party B (Japanese labels, e.g. "0～24歳"). Not the exact age; the youngest class is 0-24, so teenagers cannot be separated.

table:columns.name: party_b_type
table:columns.description: Original column: 当事者種別（当事者B）. Type of party B, e.g. passenger car, pedestrian, bicycle (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_b_vehicle_use
table:columns.description: Original column: 用途別（当事者B）. Use of party B's vehicle, e.g. private or commercial (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_b_vehicle_shape
table:columns.description: Original column: 車両形状（当事者B）. Body shape of party B's vehicle (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_b_speed_limit
table:columns.description: Original column: 速度規制（指定のみ）（当事者B）. Posted speed limit on party B's road (Japanese labels). Statutory default limits are not included.

table:columns.name: party_b_impact_point
table:columns.description: Original column: 車両の衝突部位（当事者B）. Impact points of party B's vehicle (first and second; Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_b_vehicle_damage
table:columns.description: Original column: 車両の損壊程度（当事者B）. Damage level of party B's vehicle (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_b_airbag
table:columns.description: Original column: エアバッグの装備（当事者B）. Airbag fitted and deployed for party B's vehicle (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_b_side_airbag
table:columns.description: Original column: サイドエアバッグの装備（当事者B）. Side airbag fitted and deployed for party B's vehicle (Japanese labels).

table:columns.name: party_b_injury_severity
table:columns.description: Original column: 人身損傷程度（当事者B）. Injury severity of party B (Japanese labels, e.g. "死亡" = killed, "負傷" = injured).

table:columns.name: party_b_automatic
table:columns.description: Original column: オートマチック車（当事者B）. Whether party B's vehicle is an automatic (Japanese labels). Applies to passenger cars and trucks only. Null for 2019-2021. Converted from the source codes using the official code table.

table:columns.description: Original column: サポカー（当事者B）. Whether party B's vehicle is a "Support Car" with driver-assistance safety features (Japanese labels). Null for 2019-2021. Converted from the source codes using the official code table.

table:columns.description: Original column: 運転練習の方法（当事者B）. How party B learned to drive (Japanese labels). Null for 2019-2021. Converted from the source codes using the official code table. "0" is not in the code table and is kept as in the source.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Feature bounding box (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax). The GeoParquet 1.1 bbox covering column, used to skip row groups in spatial filters.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Accident location (point, EPSG:4326). Null where the source coordinates were (0, 0) or outside Japan.
